profile.headline: Leading cloud-native development with .NET and RESTful APIs.
profile.summary:
As a Principal Software Engineer at GEICO, I focus on designing and developing secure, scalable cloud-native applications and microservices using .NET Core, C#, and Azure. My work emphasizes creating high-performance APIs, integrating Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and implementing event-driven architectures to support robust backend systems. I have also contributed to enhancing deployment efficiency through CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks.  

With over 10 years at GEICO, I specialize in delivering enterprise-grade solutions that address complex business challenges. Through collaboration with cross-functional teams, I have supported modernization initiatives and optimized cloud systems to improve reliability and scalability. My commitment to innovation and efficient system development drives impactful results for the organization
